seed-article-30.e: Iwebhusayithi ekwi-intanethi isafuna ukukhathalelwa ukuze ihlale ikhawuleza, ikhuselekile kwaye ichanekile. Nanku uluhlu lwezinto ezifanele ukujongwa rhoqo.
c: Isikrini sibonisa ikhowudi ye-React
Ukulondoloza rhoqo kugcina iwebhusayithi iphilile.
b: Abantu abaninzi bacinga ukuba iwebhusayithi igqityiwe kwangoko ngoko iqala ukuba ikwi-intanethi. Ngokwenene, njengevenkile yokwenyani, iwebhusayithi ifuna ukukhathalelwa ukuze ihlale iyonwabisa ukuyityelela kwaye ithembekile.
Oko kufuneka kujongwe rhoqo
**Ulwazi lweshishini.** Qinisekisa ukuba idilesi, iiyure zokuvula, amaxabiso neenombolo zoqhagamshelwano zisachanekile.
**Isantya.** Jonga ukuba iwebhusayithi isakhawuleza ukuvula, ngakumbi emva kokongeza iifoto.
**Amakhonkco neefom.** Zama onke amaqhosha, amakhonkco nefom yoqhagamshelwano.
**Ukhuseleko.** Hlaziya isoftware uphonononge amalungelo okufikelela.
**Iikopi zokhuseleko.** Qinisekisa ukuba kukho ikopi enokubuyiselwa ukuba kuphosakala into.
**Ukuphelelwa kwexesha kwedomeyini nokubamba iwebhusayithi.** Ungavumeli ukuba iphelelwe ngaphandle kokuqaphela.
